title: Invariant direct sums and block-diagonal operators
objectives: Prove that invariant summands are detected by commuting projections
Write a diagonalizable operator in spectral form and compute polynomials of it
Express the spectral projections as Lagrange polynomials in the operator
Prove that a spectral form implies diagonalizability
prerequisites: Direct sums and projections (Chapter 17), eigenvalues and diagonalizability (Chapters 12, 13 and 16).
source_scope: The captions of the two recordings (positions 36 and 37) were read in full. The running operator, the uniqueness and minimal-polynomial corollaries, boundary cases, laboratory and exercises are original.
